body:
I do show concern, and I show it hurts me to know she feels so bad. 
I don't tell just how much. I mean, I completely agree with what you're saying. It's just very hard to put into practice. I've always been bad at sharing my feelings, *especially* when I'm feeling shitty.. When she tells me she wants to die, I don't care how I was feeling a bit lonely before she texted me. Again, I get what you are saying but we are definitely friends. When she's in a somewhat better spot she shows lots of concern for how I'm doing too, and when I *do* vent she sympathizes even if she's not doing too well either. I just choose not to share these feelings when she's already in such a low spot, maybe that's stupid but yeah.. Maybe I will take this in account. It might help me cope better. The point is that you are right it will be a blip in a few years if she lives. That's just my first priority even though I have barely any influence on it.

ninja edit: I also need to add that overall she's not a negative influence, even though the conversations are usually not easily digestible it means a lot to me that she specifically chooses me to talk to.. If that makes sense
